date.as_written: ३२५ कार्तिक शुक्ल पूर्णमास वृहस्पतेर्दिनं [:] / शुभसंवत् ३२५ का शु पूर्ण वृ

notes: The original palm-leaf final folio is mutilated, preserving the date NS 325 and royal titles 'rājādhirāja-parameśvara-paramabha[ṭṭāraka...]' without the king's name, as well as a garbled line reading 'mahāvihārāya-sākabhirugumandraracilekhiḥ'. The scribe's name Cikiddīsiṃha is preserved on a later paper replacement folio copying the original colophon. A secondary note on the reverse of the palm leaf fragment is dated NS 579 (1459 CE).
